title: Contested Frontier
description: A hostile outpost sits between you and open territory. Hold it with a sustained escort fleet while growing a relay outpost's population — and keep the layout planar.

narrative.intro: The hostile outpost can't be removed, only pacified: route enough escort fleet there and keep it there. Meanwhile the relay outpost needs to actually grow, not just receive a one-time delivery. And route your cabling carefully — crossing lines in this sector jam each other's signal, so keep the layout crossing-free.
narrative.outro: Sustained presence, not a single delivery, is what pacified that outpost — and a clean, non-crossing layout kept every line interference-free the whole time.

goals.description: Hold at least 4 escort fleet hulls at the Hostile Outpost for 8 straight ticks.
Grow the Relay Outpost's population by exactly 2 per tick for 3 ticks in a row.
